What Is the Best Day to Move?

How moving day choice affects cost and availability.

Author: Ralph Ivey

Last updated: 2026-07-20

Experience: Written for working trucking and moving businesses.

Answer

Midweek days often provide better availability and lower pressure than weekends or month-end.
